headline: Sri Lanka won the toss and chose to bowl against Pakistan in the first Test in Rawalpindi on Monday, with Pakistan handing Test debuts to Tayyab Arif, Mohammad Taha, Arafat Minhas and Saqib Khan.

card.desc: Sri Lanka ne toss jeet kar Pakistan ko batting di.

caption:
Pakistan aur Sri Lanka ka pehla Test Rawalpindi mein shuru! 🏏
Arab News ke mutabiq Monday ko Sri Lanka ke captain Kusal Mendis ne toss jeet kar pehle bowling ka faisla kiya. Pakistan ki taraf se Tayyab Arif, Mohammad Taha, Arafat Minhas aur Saqib Khan apna pehla Test match khel rahe hain. Doosra Test 17 November se Lahore mein hoga.
Aap ke khayal mein yeh Test kaun jeetega? Comment mein batayein 👇
